definitions.explanation: A shark family named for its distinctively flattened, hammer- or T-shaped head, which spreads its eyes and sensory organs wide apart for better vision and prey detection.

examples.japanese: シュモクザメ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{特徴的|とくちょうてき}→特徴的：06740_tokuchouteki⟧だ。
examples.english: The hammerhead shark has a distinctive head shape.

examples.japanese: シュモクザメ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{群|む}れ→群れ：00298_mure⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{泳|およ}いでいる→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧のが⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: We could see a school of hammerhead sharks swimming.

examples.japanese: シュモクザメという⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{鐘|かね}→鐘：02654_kane⟧をつく⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧「{撞木|しゅもく}」⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{似|に}ている→似る：01159_niru⟧ことに⟦{由来|ゆらい}→由来：05451_yurai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The name "shumokuzame" comes from the resemblance of its head shape to a "shumoku," a mallet used to strike a temple bell.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{撞木|しゅもく} is the T-shaped mallet used to strike a temple bell; the shark is named for the similar shape of its head.
